of.needed: whether the environment has already explicitly configured tsdb schema and v13 schema versions

consequence.statement: Loki will not start during the upgrade if the environment does not have tsdb and v13 schema configured, as structured metadata is now enabled by default.

assertion.statement: Structured metadata is enabled by default in Loki 3.0.0 and requires tsdb storage backend and v13 schema configuration; Loki will not start without these.
